diff --git a/ta4j-core/src/main/java/org/ta4j/core/analysis/cost/LinearBorrowingCostModel.java b/ta4j-core/src/main/java/org/ta4j/core/analysis/cost/LinearBorrowingCostModel.java index ad7824e7f..f4e76c7c9 100644 --- a/ta4j-core/src/main/java/org/ta4j/core/analysis/cost/LinearBorrowingCostModel.java +++ b/ta4j-core/src/main/java/org/ta4j/core/analysis/cost/LinearBorrowingCostModel.java @@ -14 +14,11 @@ import org.ta4j.core.num.Num; - * linearly. + * linearly on the entry trade value: {@code entry.getValue() * indexDistance + * * feePerPeriod}. A period is one index step, not a calendar day. Later marks, + * timestamps, weekends and holidays do not change that calculation. The caller + * must supply a rate in these units; no annual-rate conversion is performed. + * + *

+ * A closed position uses its actual exit index. An open position uses the + * supplied observation index and requires that overload. The price/amount + * overload returns zero because it cannot determine a holding duration. These + * legacy conventions are preserved. Calendar/mark-based borrowing requires an + * explicitly supplied cost model with the relevant historical inputs.
